Tara (CSM): Heads-up — CerebriX shows a ~45% drop in API calls since 2025-04-28. Renewal ~5 weeks out. New Head of Data (Marta) started last week; they also opened a procurement review vs Competitor Z.
Ethan (SE): Can you share which org slug and endpoints affected? single pipeline or org-wide?
Tara (CSM): Org: cerebrix-prod. Quick metric grab:
```
2025-04-26 | 22,100
2025-04-27 | 21,900
2025-04-28 | 12,100
2025-04-29 | 11,900
```
Drop mainly on /chat/generate and nightly embedding batches.
Pri (AE): Procurement mentioned a short bake-off. We should propose a short "operational stability + predictable spend" brief and a 60–90 day safety net (committed burst) while they complete the vendor review.
access-bot: Last token rotation: 2025-03-02. Last playbook used: cs-core-v2.
Ethan (SE): Checked infra — no service regressions, no 5xx. Likely access/role change: their infra team said a service account role was removed during the org move.
Tara (CSM): Outreach plan: 1) 20-min triage with Marta + data lead today, 2) restore service account or run our rotation flow with admin consent, 3) offer a short committed-burst and a one-page TCO snapshot for procurement.
Pri (AE): I'll draft a one-pager and a mini amendment for the 60-day burst. Legal: can you pre-clear a fast-track addendum for small committed bursts?
Ethan (SE): I can prep a 10-min demo showing batching + KV cache benefits for their nightly job if they want performance comparisons.
Tara (CSM): Action items: @Ethan confirm infra clean (ETA 1hr); @Pri draft 1-pager + draft amendment (ETA EOD); @Tara schedule triage and ping Marta. I'll DM Marta now.
Pri (AE): Draft outreach below — ok to send after Tara approves:
"Hi Marta 44B Congrats on the new role. We noticed a sharp drop in CerebriX traffic aligned with your org change. Can we do a 20-min sync today to validate access and walk through two quick recovery paths? We can also put a short committed-burst in place while procurement runs the vendor comparison. 4C4 —Pri"
Tara (CSM): Send it. Keeping thread live for status and ticket updates. :white_check_mark:
